title: flightdeck/compliance/v1
description: Each repository's report as a column and each rule and suite as a row, with each cell's state, each group's roll-up and where each repository differs from the imposed rule set.

dry_run.description: Present, and true, when the run was a dry run that changed nothing.

failures.description: The failures that the answer leaves out. It is empty when nothing failed.

items.description: A failure of some of the ids: the fields of the failure document without schema.

alternatives.description: Other repairs the caller can try, in order of preference, each in the shape of recovery. It is present only when the failure offers at least one.

items.description: A repair the caller can try instead, tagged by kind.

oneOf.description: Run this command. With `all`, run it once with every value of the failure's field that `all` names in place of the argument's placeholder, such as `<ID>...`.
A person must run this command in a terminal, so a program should hand the step to a person.
Run this command of another program. `run` is the quoted command line that the text output prints.
Run the same command again later.
Make this repair, then take the step `then`.

then.description: The step that follows the repair.

oneOf.description: Run this command. With `all`, run it once with every value of the failure's field that `all` names in place of the argument's placeholder, such as `<ID>...`.
A person must run this command in a terminal, so a program should hand the step to a person.
Run the same command again later.
Follow this advice.
There is no next step, for this reason.

cause.description: The errors that led to the failure, joined with ": ". It is present only when the failure has a cause.

causes.description: The reasons the failure lists side by side, in order, one sentence each. It is present only when the failure lists at least one.

code.description: The failure's stable code, such as shelf::books::not_found. It is one or more printable ASCII characters without spaces, from ! to ~.

fields.description: The values at fault, in the order the failure gives them, each under a name of one or more lowercase ASCII letters, digits and underscores. A value is a string, an integer, a boolean, null, or an array or object of such values, and an object holds each key once. It is present only when the failure names at least one.

index.description: The position of key among the keys that the caller gave, counted from 0, so two failures of the same key differ. It is present only with key.

key.description: The key that the caller gave for the answer that failed, when the failure is one answer of a batch.

labels.description: The places in a source, such as a file, that the failure points at, in the order the failure gives them. It is present only when the failure has at least one label.

column.description: The 1-based column of the start of the span, counted in characters of its line. It is present only when the span could be read.

excerpt.description: The lines of the source that the span covers, with one line before and one after where the source has them. It is present only when the span could be read.

line.description: The 1-based number of the first line of the excerpt.

text.description: The lines, joined by the line breaks of the source, without a line break at the end.

length.description: The length of the span in bytes.

line.description: The 1-based line that holds the start of the span. It is present only when the span could be read.

name.description: The name of the source, such as a file name. It is present only when the span could be read and the source has a name.

offset.description: The byte offset of the start of the span from the start of the source.

text.description: What the label says about the span. It is present only when the label has text.

recovery.description: What the caller can do next, tagged by kind.

oneOf.description: Run this command. With `all`, run it once with every value of the failure's field that `all` names in place of the argument's placeholder, such as `<ID>...`.
A person must run this command in a terminal, so a program should hand the step to a person.
Run this command of another program. `run` is the quoted command line that the text output prints.
Run the same command again later.
Make this repair, then take the step `then`.

then.description: The step that follows the repair.

oneOf.description: Run this command. With `all`, run it once with every value of the failure's field that `all` names in place of the argument's placeholder, such as `<ID>...`.
A person must run this command in a terminal, so a program should hand the step to a person.
Run the same command again later.
Follow this advice.
There is no next step, for this reason.

related.description: The diagnostics that the failure's diagnostic relates to it, in the order it gives them. It is present only when there is at least one.

cause.description: The errors below the related diagnostic, joined with ": ". It is present only when there is one.

code.description: The related diagnostic's own code, which is free text. It is present only when the diagnostic has one.

help.description: The related diagnostic's advice. It is present only when it gives some.

labels.description: The places in a source, such as a file, that the failure points at, in the order the failure gives them. It is present only when the failure has at least one label.

column.description: The 1-based column of the start of the span, counted in characters of its line. It is present only when the span could be read.

excerpt.description: The lines of the source that the span covers, with one line before and one after where the source has them. It is present only when the span could be read.

line.description: The 1-based number of the first line of the excerpt.

text.description: The lines, joined by the line breaks of the source, without a line break at the end.

length.description: The length of the span in bytes.

line.description: The 1-based line that holds the start of the span. It is present only when the span could be read.

name.description: The name of the source, such as a file name. It is present only when the span could be read and the source has a name.

offset.description: The byte offset of the start of the span from the start of the source.

text.description: What the label says about the span. It is present only when the label has text.

related.description: The diagnostics related to this one, in the same shape, to at most eight levels below the failure.

severity.description: How severe the related diagnostic is. A diagnostic that gives no severity is an error.

url.description: A page that explains the related diagnostic. It is present only when it has one.

sentence.description: A fixed sentence that a person reviewed, safe to show to anyone. It is present only when the failure has one.

url.description: A page that explains the failure. It is present only when the failure has one.

BranchRun.description:
One finished run of a repository's workflow on its branch, as the fetch
record names it.

age_s.description:
Whole seconds from the run's start to the build; null when its time
cannot be read.

branch.description: The branch the run ran on.

commit.description: The commit the run checked out.

run_number.description: The run's number in its workflow.

started_at.description: When the run started, in UTC.

uploaded.description: Whether the run holds the report's artifact.

BuildRun.description: The controls job's run that built the document.

label.description:
The run's label for people, such as `Build run #412`; null when
only its address was given.

url.description: The run's address; null when only its label was given.

Cell.description: One rule's or suite's cell in one repository.

age_s.description:
Whole seconds from the suite's run to the build; null for a rule or
a suite with no run.

code.description:
Why the cell is not readable: the rule's or the suite's code in the
report, or the column's code; null otherwise.

facts.description:
What the rule's checker measured; null for a suite or an absent
rule.

result.description:
The rule's `result` as the report gives it; null for a suite or an
absent rule.

run.description:
The suite's newest qualifying run as the report gives it, with its
commits since; null for a rule or a suite with no run.

oneOf.description:
A budget is over, a pin is behind, a measure is not 0, or the
newest run failed a case.

The report or the suite's newest clean run is older than the
window, or no clean run exists.

The cell cannot be judged: the report holds a refusal, a result
this build does not know, or a rule the repository holds itself.

The rule is met, or the suite's newest clean run passed within the
window.
The rule has no checker that a report measures.
The rule or suite does not reach this repository.

ComplianceDocument.description:
The compliance of every repository the config names, as the pages draw
it.

build_run.description:
The controls job's run that built the document, from `--build-run`
and `--build-url`; null when neither was given.

built_at.description: When the build ran, in UTC.

counts.description: How many rule and suite cells read each state, in every column.

groups.description: Each group of rules and its roll-up, by path.

imposed.description: The imposed rule set that drift is measured against.

next_build_at.description:
When the next build runs, from the config's `[build] every_hours`;
null when the config names no interval.

reports.description: How many repositories' reports read each state.

repositories.description: Each repository, in the config's order.

rows.description:
Each rule and suite: measured rules, zero rules, suites and then
written rules, each by path.

site.description:
The files that `--out` wrote, which only the printed document holds;
absent without `--out` and in `compliance.json`.

stale_after_days.description:
The most whole days since a report or a suite's run before it reads
stale.

title.description: The pages' title, from the config.

Differs.description: One imposed rule that the repository holds with different fields.

Drift.description: Where one repository differs from the imposed rule set.

behind.description:
Whether the report read an older commit of the set: its
`board.rules_commit` is not the commit `--rules-commit` names. Null
when the build was given no `--rules-commit`.

differs.description:
The imposed rules the repository also holds with different fields,
as the report lists them.

extra.description:
The repository's own rules with no imposed rule of the same path,
as the report lists them.

not_reached.description:
The imposed rules that reach no file in the repository, as the
report lists them.

other_set.description:
Whether the report read another rule set: its `board.rules_from`
is not the config's `imposed.from`, or its `imposed.root` is not
the config's `imposed.root`.

FailedCase.description: One case that failed or erred.

note.description: The run's note on the case, or null.

FileOver.description: One file over a per-file budget.

file.description: The file, from the repository's root.

Group.description: One group of rules and its roll-up in each repository.

cells.description:
The group's roll-up in each repository, in the order of the
document's `repositories`.

members.description: The ids of the imposed rules in the group, by path.

title.description: The group's name for people, or its path when no report names it.

GroupCell.description: One group's roll-up in one repository.

counts.description:
How many of the group's members found each result, as the
repository's report counted them; null when the report holds no
such group.

state.description:
The worst state of the members' cells in this repository, or
`absent` when no member reaches it.

ImposedSet.description: The imposed rule set, as the config names it.

branch.description:
The branch of the set's repository that the build read, from
`--rules-branch`; absent when the build was not told it.

commit.description:
The set's current commit, from `--rules-commit`; null when the build
was not told it.

from.description: The rules board's origin in identity form.

root.description: The set's root in the rules board.

MeasureValue.description: One value a run recorded for a measure: a number, a label or a flag.

anyOf.description: A number, such as a count.

Omitted.description: How many items each list of a rule's facts left out.

PinBehind.description: One pin older than a version rule's minimum.

file.description: The file, from the repository's root.

line.description: The line the pin is on, from 1.

Refused.description: One refusal or warning a report met.

rules.description: The rules or groups it concerns, by path.

ReportCounts.description: How many repositories' reports read each state.

current.description: Reports no older than the window.

invalid_report.description: Report files the build cannot read.

ReportState.description: What a repository's report reads as.

oneOf.description: The report is no older than the window.

The report is older than the window, so its current cells read
stale.
No report file is at the repository's path.
The report file is not a report the build reads.

age_s.description:
Whole seconds from the report to the build; null without a
readable report.

board_version.description: The Board version that made the report.

code.description:
`flightdeck::compliance::no_report` or
`flightdeck::compliance::invalid_report`; null when the report was
read.

commit.description: The commit the report read; null when it read none.

commits_since.description:
Commits on the branch since the report's commit, from the fetch
record; absent when not counted, and for a column that reads no
report.

commits_since_code.description:
Why a read report's `commits_since` is absent, such as
`flightdeck::compliance::compare_failed`; absent otherwise.

committed.description: When that commit was made; null when unknown.

counts.description: How many of the column's rule and suite cells read each state.

drift.description:
Where the repository differs from the imposed set; null without a
readable report.

every_hours.description:
The hours between two runs of the repository's job, from its source
in the config; absent when the config names none.

field.description:
The path of the field that made the report invalid, such as
`rules[0].result`; null otherwise.

generated.description: When the report was made; null without a readable report.

group.description: The heading the pages show it under, from the config.

message.description: What made the report invalid; null otherwise.

name.description: The repository's name, as the config gives it.

newest_run.description:
The newest finished run of the repository's workflow on its branch,
from the fetch record; absent without one, or when the workflow has
no run.

refused.description: Each refusal and warning the report met, as it lists them.

report.description: What the repository's report reads as.

report_run.description:
The run the report beside the fetch record came from; absent without
a fetch record, or when no run held a report.

rules_commit.description: The rules board's commit the report read.

rules_from.description: The rules board's origin the report read.

source_run.description:
The CI run that made the report, copied from the report; null for a
local report.

uncommitted.description:
Whether a tracked file differed from the commit; null without a
readable report.

Row.description: One rule or suite and its cell in each repository.

cases.description:
How many cases the suite lists, from the first report that holds
it; null for a rule.

cells.description:
The row's cell in each repository, in the order of the document's
`repositories`.

groups.description: The paths of the groups the rule is in, in any report.

id.description: The rule's or the suite's path.

paths.description:
The globs of the files the rule applies to, such as `**/*.py`, from
the first report that gives them; absent for a suite and for a rule
no report gives them for.

purpose.description: Why the requirement exists; null as for `requirement`.

requirement.description:
What the files must do, from the first report that holds the rule,
taking first the reports on the `--rules-commit` commit; null for a
suite or a rule that cannot be read.

section.description: The part of the matrix the row sits in.

show.description: When the rule is shown to an agent; null for a suite.

source.description:
`imposed` or `repository`, from the report's `rules[].source`; null
for a suite.

RuleFacts.description: The facts a rule's checker measured, which a cell copies.

behind.description: Each pin older than a version rule's minimum, at most 20.

files.description: The files a budget or version rule read, at most 20.

max.description: A budget's max, or null for any other rule.

omitted.description: How many items each list above left out.

over.description: Each file over a per-file budget, at most 20.

used.description: What a budget's files use, or null for any other rule.

zero.description: What a zero rule's suite's latest run reported, or null.

RuleSource.description:
Where a rule comes from. Board's schema allows only these two values,
so a report with another is invalid at that rule's `source`.

oneOf.description: A rule of the imposed set.
A rule of the repository's own.

Section.description: Which part of the matrix a row sits in.

oneOf.description: A budget or version rule, which a report measures.
A zero rule, read from a suite's newest run.
A compliance suite, from its newest clean full run.

A pattern, judged or written rule, or one whose checker a report
cannot read, which a report lists and does not measure.

SiteFiles.description: The files that `--out` wrote, as the printed document names them.

warnings.description:
The codes of the warnings about the page, such as
`flightdeck::compliance::over_flare_cap` for a page over Flare's
4 MiB cap. A warning leaves the exit code at 0.

SourceRun.description:
The GitHub Actions run that made a report. The document copies it as it
is.

commit.description: The commit the run checked out, from `GITHUB_SHA`.

repository.description: The repository whose workflow ran, from `GITHUB_REPOSITORY`.

run_number.description: The run's number in its workflow, from `GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER`.

StateCounts.description: How many cells read each state.

SuiteRun.description: A suite's newest qualifying run. A cell copies it as it is.

commit.description: The commit the run's `versions` name, or null.

commits_since.description:
Commits on the repository since the run's commit, or null when Board
could not count them.

commits_since_code.description: Why `commits_since` is null, or null when it was counted.

failed.description: Each case that failed or erred.

finished.description:
When the run finished, or started when it records no finish; null
when it records neither as a time.

id.description: The run, by its logical path.

ZeroRead.description: What a zero rule's suite's latest run reported.

age_s.description: Whole seconds from the run's finish to the report, or null.

measures.description:
Each measure the rule names and the value the run recorded, or
null when it recorded none.

run.description: The run, by its logical path, or null when none qualifies.

suite.description: The suite, by its logical path.
